messages:
anya: Quick flag — customer Solstice finetune merge + int4 quant shows many <unk> tokens in invoice extraction. Looks like tokenizer mismatch (finetune used spm v2).

bryce: Do we see consistent id offsets or just missing tokens?

anya: Consistent offset for a bucket of tokens. Example quick repro: `python eval_pack/run_eval.py --pack solstice_invoice_200 --model merged_solstice_lora --quant int4`

li: Paste a short example?

anya: INPUT: "Invoice total: $123.45\nList items."
FP16: "1. Consulting - $100.00"
INT4: "1. <unk> - $100.00"
Token diff: ":" id 58 in fp16, id 61 in int4 (post-merge).

nate: That screams vocab mismatch at merge. Two options: remap LoRA embeddings to base vocab ids, or retokenize finetune before merging. Remapping is faster for the customer.

anya: I ran our rebase script: `tools/tokenmap/rebase_lora.py --in lora_solstice.pt --map v2_to_v3.json --out lora_solstice_rebase.pt` — it completes. Can @eval-bot run solstice_invoice_200 against fp16, int4(before), int4(rebased)?

eval-bot: queued 5087654335: solstice_invoice_200 on merged_solstice_lora fp16, int4_raw, int4_rebased. ETA ~12m.

nate: Interim: fp16 EM 0.92, int4_raw EM 0.57, int4_rebased EM 0.86. Good improvement but some edge templates still fail (rare tokens).

bryce: For the remaining failures, surface-string fallback mapping might fix OOVs. Also add a gating check: abort merge if finetune tokenizer != base tokenizer unless remap.json provided.

li: I'll draft the gating check and a tiny 50-prompt adversarial set capturing custom invoice templates. Add a quick-regression test that ensures EM drop <= 0.05 between fp16 and int4_rebased.

anya: Sounds good. I'll open the PR for: (1) include rebase step in merge CI, (2) add regression test to solstice pack, (3) attach repro commands + sample vectors.

bryce: :thumbsup: also add a short note in the onboarding checklist so solutions engineers know to warn customers about tokenizer mismatches.

anya: Will do. If anyone wants to run more comparisons (retokenize vs rebase vs remap-with-calibration) I can queue extra runs.
